1315.name: Unsuspecting Foe
1315.description:
Increased critical-hit chance against disabled or defiant foes.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1316.name: Sundering Burst
1316.description:
Burst skills inflict vulnerability if they hit and inflict additional vulnerability if the attack is a critical hit.
Can only occur once per interval per target for multihit burst skills.

1317.name: Heightened Focus
1317.description: Gain quickness and recharge your <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skills when you strike a foe that is below the health threshold. Gain increased outgoing healing when you strike with a <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skill, based on adrenaline spent.

1329.name: Crack Shot
1329.description: Your longbow, rifle, and harpoon gun weapon skill 1 attacks are enhanced.

1333.name: Blademaster
1333.description: Gain expertise. Gain condition damage while wielding a sword. Sword skills gain reduced recharge.

1334.name: Opportunist
1334.description: Gain fury and adrenaline when you immobilize or disable a foe.

1336.name: Burst Precision
1336.description: <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skills have an increased critical chance. Gain bonus critical-hit chance and ferocity for a duration when you hit with a burst skill. Duration is based on adrenaline spent.

1337.name: Bloodlust
1337.description: You have a chance to inflict bleeding on critical hits, and bleeds that you apply last longer.

1338.name: Forceful Greatsword
1338.description: Gain power and a chance to gain might on critical strike. Double these bonuses while wielding a greatsword or underwater spear. Greatsword and underwater spear skills recharge faster.

1342.name: Furious Burst
1342.description: Gain fury when you swap weapons. Fury gives an increased critical chance.

1343.name: Deep Strikes
1343.description: Gain condition damage when you have fury. You have increased chance to critically strike against bleeding foes.

1344.name: Signet Mastery
1344.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> grant a stacking ferocity boon on use. Cast Lesser Signet of Might when striking a foe below the health threshold.

1346.name: Furious
1346.description: Critical hits grant bonus adrenaline and gain a stacking condition damage effect.

1348.name: Adrenal Health
1348.description: Gain health based on adrenaline spent.

1350.name: Thick Skin
1350.description: Gain protection when you use a healing skill.

1367.name: Merciless Hammer
1367.description:
Hammer and mace skills deal increased damage when striking a disabled or defiant foe. Gain adrenaline when you disable a foe.
Disables include stun, taunt, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, fear, and launch.

1368.name: Defy Pain
1368.description: Cast Lesser Endure Pain when you use an elite skill.

1369.name: Axe Mastery
1369.description: Gain ferocity. Gain additional ferocity when wielding an axe. Axe skills gain reduced recharge and grant adrenaline when critically striking.

1372.name: Cull the Weak
1372.description: Deal increased strike damage to weakened foes. <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skills inflict weakness. <c=@reminder>Can only occur once per interval per target for multihit burst skills.</c>

1375.name: Last Stand
1375.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stances</c> grant vigor and barrier when activated, and they have increased duration.

1376.name: Shield Master
1376.description: Reflect missiles whenever you are blocking. Gain adrenaline when you block an attack or reflect a missile.

1380.name: Hardened Armor
1380.description: Gain resolution when you block or are struck by a critical hit. Strike damage taken is reduced by a percentage while you have resolution.

1381.name: Stalwart Focus
1381.description: Increase your incoming healing effectiveness and healing to other allies.

1413.name: Warrior's Sprint
1413.description: Run faster while wielding melee weapons, and deal increased strike damage while you have swiftness. Movement skills break immobilization when used.

1416.name: Fast Hands
1416.description: Gain swiftness when swapping weapons in combat.

1417.name: Versatile Power
1417.description: Gain might on weapon swap. <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skills gain reduced recharge.

1437.name: Berserker's Power
1437.description: Gain increased strike damage when you use a <c=@abilitytype>burst</c> skill; this damage increase is based on your adrenaline.

1440.name: Aggressive Onslaught
1440.description: Gain quickness when you disable an enemy. While you have quickness, your movement speed is increased. <c=@reminder>This stacks with other movement speed increases.</c>

1444.name: Peak Performance
1444.description: Deal increased strike damage. <c=@abilitytype>Physical</c> skills further increase all outgoing strike damage for a period of time.

1446.name: Reckless Dodge
1446.description: Damage foes at the end of a dodge roll.

1447.name: Brave Stride
1447.description: Movement skills grant boons and adrenaline when used.

1449.name: Great Fortitude
1449.description: Gain vitality and ferocity based on a percentage of your power.

1451.name: Restorative Strength
1451.description: Using a heal skill grants might.

1453.name: Pinnacle of Strength
1453.description: Might applied to you grants more power. Your critical-hit chance is increased.

1454.name: Might Makes Right
1454.description: Gain health and endurance whenever you apply might to yourself.

1455.name: Wounding Precision
1455.description: Gain expertise based on your precision.

1469.name: Leg Specialist
1469.description: Immobilize a target when you cripple them with a skill. Deal increased strike damage to foes affected with movement-impairing conditions.

1470.name: Vigorous Shouts
1470.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shout</c> skills heal allies. Gain healing power based on your power.

1471.name: Roaring Reveille
1471.description: Warhorn skills apply additional boons. Your concentration is increased.

1474.name: Soldier's Comfort
1474.description: Soldier's Focus heals affected allies and grants them protection.

1479.name: Shrug It Off
1479.description: Use "Shake It Off!" when you use a healing skill. Removing a damaging condition from an ally heals them.

1480.name: Marching Orders
1480.description: Periodically gain Soldier's Focus. Hitting with a burst skill expends Soldier's Focus to grant might to nearby allies.

1481.name: Mending Might
1481.description: Applying might to an ally heals you.

1482.name: Empower Allies
1482.description: While you are in combat, grant might to yourself and nearby allies each interval.

1484.name: Doubled Standards
1484.description: <c=@abilitytype>Banners</c> grant resolution to allies when they are dropped. Pulsing boons applied through <c=@abilitytype>banners</c> last longer.

1485.name: Empowered
1485.description: Deal increased strike damage for every boon on you.

1486.name: Warrior's Cunning
1486.description:
Deal increased strike damage to foes above the health threshold. Also deal more damage to foes with barrier.
Damage bonuses do not stack.

1488.name: Dogged March
1488.description: Reduce the duration of movement-impeding conditions and gain regeneration when you are affected by one of these conditions.

1489.name: Destruction of the Empowered
1489.description: Deal increased strike damage per boon on your target.

1649.name: Cleansing Ire
1649.description: Gain adrenaline when hit. Remove a condition when you hit with a <c=@abilitytype>burst</c> skill, then remove an additional condition for every bar of adrenaline spent.

1657.name: Burst Mastery
1657.description: <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skills deal more damage, grant swiftness, and restore a portion of adrenaline spent.

1667.name: Martial Cadence
1667.description: Soldier's Focus grants boons to affected allies and removes conditions from them. Refresh Soldier's Focus when you swap weapons.

1707.name: Dual Wielding
1707.description: Attack speed is increased when wielding a main-hand weapon in your off hand. Heal when you critically strike a foe while wielding a main-hand weapon in your off hand. This heal is increased when critically striking a bleeding foe.

1708.name: Stalwart Strength
1708.description: Gain stability when you disable a foe. Deal increased strike damage while you have stability.

1709.name: Brawler's Recovery
1709.description: Remove conditions when you swap weapons.

1711.name: Phalanx Strength
1711.description: When you grant yourself might, grant it to nearby allies as well.

1831.name: Primal Rage
1831.description: Gain access to berserk mode and <c=@abilitytype>primal bursts</c>.

1928.name: Bloody Roar
1928.description: Deal increased strike damage while in berserk mode. Gain resistance when entering berserk mode.

1977.name: Savage Instinct
1977.description: Activating berserk mode breaks stuns. Reduce incoming damage for a period of time when entering berserk mode.

1993.name: Burst of Aggression
1993.description: Gain a burst of speed when entering berserk mode.

2000.name: Body Blow
2000.description: Stuns, dazes, knockbacks, pulls, pushes, and launches inflict vulnerability and weakness.

2002.name: Dead or Alive
2002.description: Heal yourself and gain Blood Reckoning when entering berserk mode.

2011.name: Blood Reaction
2011.description: A percentage of precision is given as a bonus to ferocity and a percentage of power is given as a bonus to condition damage. These bonuses are doubled in berserk mode.

2038.name: King of Fires
2038.description: Increase the duration of burning you apply. Gain fire aura when you critically hit an enemy. Berserker skills detonate fire aura, damaging and burning nearby foes.

2039.name: Last Blaze
2039.description: When you use a <c=@abilitytype>rage</c> skill, inflict burning on nearby enemies.<c=@abilitytype>Rage</c> skills extend berserk longer.

2042.name: Heat the Soul
2042.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you hit an enemy with a <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skill.

2046.name: Fatal Frenzy
2046.description: Berserk mode increases power and condition damage.

2049.name: Smash Brawler
2049.description: When you hit with a <c=@abilitytype>Primal Burst</c> skill, extend the duration of your berserk. Critical-hit chance is increased while berserk.

2060.name: Magebane Tether
2060.description: Hitting with a <c=@abilitytype>burst</c> skill casts Magebane Tether on your target if they are within range.

2095.name: Sun and Moon Style
2095.description:
Gain bonuses for each dagger you equip:
Main hand—Strike damage is increased versus foes with no boons.
Off hand—Heal for a percent of your outgoing strike damage.

2107.name: Pure Strike
2107.description: Deal increased critical-hit damage. This bonus is doubled against boonless foes.

2126.name: Loss Aversion
2126.description: Removing boons from a foe deals damage and gives you adrenaline.

2130.name: Attacker's Insight
2130.description:
Gain Insight when disabling foes or removing boons. Full Counter refreshes all burst skills on hit.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt and fear.

2153.name: Guard Counter
2153.description: Gain protection after a successful Full Counter.

2162.name: Dispelling Force
2162.description: Dazes, stuns, pulls, knockdowns, knockbacks, and launches remove boons.

2163.name: Enchantment Collapse
2163.description: Removing a boon from a foe causes all nearby foes to lose additional boons.

2168.name: Resolute Counter
2168.description: Full Counter heals and removes conditions from you.

2175.name: Spellbreaker's Conviction
2175.description: Maximum adrenaline is capped at 2 bars, and only level 1 bursts are available. Gain access to the Full Counter burst and <c=@abilitytype>Meditation</c> skills.

2225.name: Unseen Sword
2225.description: Strike nearby enemies and gain increased flow rate when swapping to the gunsaber.

2226.name: Gun X Sword
2226.description: Gain access to the <c=@abilitytype>Gunsaber</c> as an alternate weapon set, but lose the ability to swap to other weapon sets during combat. Adrenaline is replaced with <c=@abilitytype>flow</c>.

2236.name: Guns and Glory
2236.description: Gain ferocity for a short duration when you hit with an <c=@abilitytype>explosion</c>. This effect stacks duration.

2237.name: River's Flow
2237.description: Load your gunsaber with ammunition that supports allies, changing its properties. Grant boons to nearby allies and gain positive flow when swapping to the gunsaber.

2239.name: Unyielding Dragon
2239.description: Dragon Slash becomes unblockable and ignores blindness. Gain might whenever you convert flow into charges.

2242.name: Dragonscale Defense
2242.description: Gain boons when entering Dragon Trigger.

2245.name: Daring Dragon
2245.description: Dragon Slash has a lower maximum charge level and consumes more flow per charge, but its effectiveness per charge is increased. Grant boons to nearby allies when you use Dragon Slash.

2253.name: Unshakable Mountain
2253.description: Grant barrier to nearby allies when you convert a certain amount of flow into charges.

2260.name: Sharp as the Wind
2260.description: Load your gunsaber with ammunition that inflicts damaging conditions, changing its properties. Burn nearby enemies and gain increased flow rate when swapping to the gunsaber.

2261.name: Immortal Dragon
2261.description: Dragon Slash heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt. Grant protection to allies whenever you convert a certain amount of flow into charges.

2302.name: Fierce as Fire
2302.description: Gain increased strike and condition damage for each round of ammunition spent.

2303.name: Lush Forest
2303.description:
Using the first round of ammo on an ammunition skill reduces the recharge of all warrior skills.
Does not affect the recharge of Unsheathe Gunsaber, Sheathe Gunsaber, and Dragon Trigger.

2307.name: Eternal Champion
2307.description: Gain stability and endurance when entering berserk mode. Traits that trigger when entering berserk mode also trigger when exiting berserk mode. You can now exit berserk mode early.

2340.name: Unyielding Resolve
2340.description: Strike and condition damage dealt to you is reduced for each point of motivation you have.

2345.name: Call to Action
2345.description: Gain motivation when you enter combat. If no refrains are active, automatically activate the refrain of Chant of Action.

2357.name: Liberating Liaise
2357.description: Chant of Freedom grants superspeed to affected allies when activated.

2369.name: Feverish Pulse
2369.description: Using a chant reduces the recharge of your other chants and grants boons to affected allies.

2373.name: Rally the Valiant
2373.description: Gain access to chants and command skills. Gain motivation by using a chant or by using a burst skill while a refrain is active.

2375.name: Brisk Pacing
2375.description: Deal increased damage based on your motivation level.

2385.name: Strengthening Stanzas
2385.description: Refrains grant bonus effects to you while they are active.

2399.name: Reverberation
2399.description: Command echoes can trigger a second time.

2418.name: Inspiring Implements
2418.description:
Gain concentration. Gain adrenaline and motivation when you swap weapons.
Motivation can only be gained while a refrain is active.

2426.name: Invigorating Tempo
2426.description: Heal yourself and gain adrenaline for each point of motivation spent.

2428.name: Enduring Refrain
2428.description: Refrain effects of chants are stronger. Gain additional motivation when you activate a chant.

2433.name: Calming Tongue
2433.description: Chant of Recuperation removes conditions from affected allies when activated.

14268.name: Reckless Impact
14268.description: Damage foes at the end of your dodge roll. Gain might for each foe struck by this attack.

14353.name: Eviscerate
14353.description: Burst. Leap at your foe with a devastating attack. Effect increases with adrenaline level. Gain might if this attack hits.

14354.name: Throw Bolas
14354.description: Physical. Throw bolas to immobilize your foe.

14355.name: Signet of Rage
14355.description:
Signet Passive: Grants adrenaline while in combat.
Signet Active: Gain fury, might, and swiftness.

14359.name: Staggering Blow
14359.description: Push back nearby foes with a staggering blow.

14360.name: Rifle Butt
14360.description: Knock back your foe with your rifle butt. Recover ammunition for each of your other rifle skills and fully recharge your rifle burst skills. Successfully striking a foe reduces the recharge time of this skill.

14361.name: Shield Bash
14361.description: Bash your foe with your shield and stun them.

14363.name: Hamstring
14363.description: Cripple your foe with a precise slash.

14364.name: Sever Artery
14364.description: Chain. Bleed your foe with a slash.

14365.name: Gash
14365.description: Chain. Bleed your foe with a gash.

14366.name: Savage Leap
14366.description: Lunge at your foe and strike them with your sword.

14368.name: Frenzy
14368.description: Stance. Frenzy to gain quickness and might.

14371.name: Triple Chop
14371.description: Deliver three final chops to your foe.

14372.name: "Shake It Off!"
14372.description: Shout. Cure conditions on yourself and nearby allies. Also breaks stuns for affected allies.

14374.name: Brutal Strike
14374.description: Hit your foe with a final brutal strike.

14375.name: Arcing Slice
14375.description: Burst. Deliver a circular attack to foes around you, and gain fury. Deal more damage to foes with low health.

14378.name: Pulverize
14378.description: Thrash your foe, leaving them weakened.

14381.name: Arcing Arrow
14381.description: Shoot a slow, arcing arrow that explodes on impact.

14385.name: Hammer Smash
14385.description: Smash the ground and damage nearby foes.

14386.name: Fierce Blow
14386.description:
Weaken your foe with a fierce blow, dealing increased damage when striking a controlled or defiant foe.
Controls include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

14387.name: Earthshaker
14387.description: Burst. Jump to the targeted location and slam your hammer down, damaging and stunning foes.

14388.name: Stomp
14388.description: Physical. Gain stability and launch nearby foes into the air with a powerful stomp. Gain stability for each enemy struck.

14389.name: Healing Signet
14389.description:
Signet Passive: Regenerate health.
Signet Active: Heal yourself, and grant yourself resistance.

14392.name: Endure Pain
14392.description: Stance. Take no damage from attacks. You are still susceptible to conditions and control effects.

14393.name: Charge
14393.description: Grant boons and remove movement-impairing conditions from allies.

14394.name: Call of Valor
14394.description: Removes conditions from allies and grants them vigor. Affected targets also gain barrier.

14396.name: Kill Shot
14396.description: Burst. Fire a powerful shot. Damage increases with adrenaline level. Deal increased damage to enemies that are affected by crowd control or below the health threshold.

14398.name: Throw Axe
14398.description: Throw an axe that cripples foes, dealing bonus damage at lower health thresholds.

14399.name: Whirling Axe
14399.description: Spin and attack nearby foes. You can move while spinning.

14400.name: Riposte
14400.description: Block the next attack. Riposte and bleed your foe if you block a melee attack. Gain adrenaline if you are not attacked.

14401.name: Mending
14401.description: Physical. Remove conditions and heal yourself.

14402.name: "To the Limit!"
14402.description: Shout. Heal yourself and regain all adrenaline. Nearby allies gain endurance.

14403.name: "For Great Justice!"
14403.description: Shout. Grant fury and might to yourself and allies.

14404.name: Signet of Might
14404.description:
Signet Passive: Improves power.
Signet Active: Attacks are unblockable and you gain might.

14405.name: Banner of Strength
14405.description: Banner. Place a banner that damages and dazes foes on initial placement, then pulses boons to you and nearby allies afterward.

14406.name: Berserker Stance
14406.description: Stance. Gain adrenaline for a short time. Gain pulsing resistance.

14407.name: Banner of Discipline
14407.description: Banner. Place a banner that damages and applies conditions to foes on initial placement, then pulses additional boons to you and nearby allies afterward.

14408.name: Banner of Tactics
14408.description: Banner. Place a banner that grants boons and superspeed and breaks stuns on initial placement, then pulses boons to you and nearby allies afterward.

14409.name: "Fear Me!"
14409.description: Shout. Induce fear in your foes. Fear duration increases based on your distance to the enemy.

14410.name: Signet of Fury
14410.description:
Signet Passive: Improves precision.
Signet Active: Gain adrenaline and improve your precision and ferocity.

14412.name: Balanced Stance
14412.description: Stance. Gain stability and swiftness on an interval. Become immune to critical hits.

14413.name: Dolyak Signet
14413.description:
Signet Passive: Reduces incoming damage.
Signet Active: Heal yourself and gain stability.

14414.name: Skull Crack
14414.description: Burst. Stun your foe with a skull crack. Effect increases with adrenaline level.

14415.name: Tremor
14415.description: Smash the ground with your mace, damaging your target and sending out a shock wave that damages and knocks down foes. Recharge Crushing Blow if you strike an enemy.

14416.name: Volley
14416.description: Fire a volley of shots at your foe.

14418.name: Dual Strike
14418.description: Strike your foe with both weapons. Gain quickness for each strike that hits.

14419.name: Battle Standard
14419.description: Banner. Place a battle standard that revives fallen allies and finishes downed foes. Once placed, the banner periodically grants boons to allies.

14421.name: Cyclone Axe
14421.description: Spin around and attack all nearby foes, applying vulnerability each hit. Gain fury for each foe hit.

14422.name: Eviscerate
14422.description: Burst. Leap at your foe with a devastating attack. Effect increases with adrenaline level. Gain might if this attack hits.

14425.name: Skull Crack
14425.description: Burst. Stun your foe with a skull crack. Effect increases with adrenaline level.

14431.name: Dual Shot
14431.description: Shoot a pair of arrows at your foe.

14432.name: Fierce Shot
14432.description: Fire a shot at your target. Gain might if you strike a vulnerable target.

14439.name: Impale
14439.description: Impale your foe and cripple them.

14440.name: Mariner's Frenzy
14440.description: Attack foes in front of you with a series of strikes.

14441.name: Parry
14441.description: Block your foe. Counterattack with a powerful strike. Gain adrenaline if you are not attacked.

14443.name: Whirling Strike
14443.description: Burst. Strike all foes around you. Effect increases with adrenaline level.

14447.name: Whirlwind Attack
14447.description: Whirl in a target's direction, slashing foes along your path.

14465.name: Repeating Shot
14465.description: Fire multiple shots that push back your foe.

14466.name: Puncture Shot
14466.description: Make your foe vulnerable with a shot to their vitals.

14467.name: Knot Shot
14467.description: Evade backward and fire a shot that immobilizes your foe.

14469.name: Forceful Shot
14469.description: Burst. Fire a forceful shot. Damage increases with adrenaline level.

14472.name: Explosive Shell
14472.description: Shoot an explosive round that explodes when it hits, striking nearby enemies and enemies in a cone behind the initial target.

14473.name: Kill Shot
14473.description: Burst. Fire a powerful shot. Damage increases with adrenaline level. Deal increased damage to enemies that are affected by crowd control or below the health threshold.

14474.name: Kill Shot
14474.description: Burst. Fire a powerful shot. Damage increases with adrenaline level. Deal increased damage to enemies that are affected by crowd control or below the health threshold.

14475.name: Kill Shot
14475.description: Burst. Fire a powerful shot. Damage increases with adrenaline level. Deal increased damage to enemies that are affected by crowd control or below the health threshold.

14479.name: Signet of Stamina
14479.description:
Signet Passive: Faster endurance regeneration.
Signet Active: Cure all conditions and gain endurance. Gain additional endurance for each condition cured.

14480.name: Tsunami Slash
14480.description: Spin forward and strike foes along the way.

14481.name: Split Shot
14481.description: Your shot splits into a spread of harpoons that each bleed your target.

14482.name: Hammer Shock
14482.description: Smash the ground and send out a crippling wave.

14483.name: Rampage
14483.description: Physical. Take the form of a massive juggernaut, reducing the damage you take and the duration of incoming movement-impeding conditions.

14498.name: Impale
14498.description: Throw your sword at your foe to impale them.

14501.name: Rip
14501.description: Rip your sword from your foe for extra damage.

14502.name: Kick
14502.description: Physical. Push your foe back with a kick.

14503.name: Pommel Bash
14503.description: Daze your foe with a brutal pommel bash. If you strike a foe that is using a skill, gain barrier.

14504.name: Pin Down
14504.description: Fire an arrow that bleeds and immobilizes your target.

14505.name: Smoldering Arrow
14505.description: Shoot an arrow that explodes on impact, blinding foes.

14506.name: Combustive Shot
14506.description: Burst. Ignite target area, burning nearby foes. Effect increases with adrenaline level.

14507.name: Counterblow
14507.description: Block the next attack. Counter with an attack if you are in melee range.

14510.name: Bladetrail
14510.description: Throw your greatsword at your foe so that it returns to you, immobilizing foes along the way.

14511.name: Backbreaker
14511.description:
Knock down your foe. Weakened foes stay knocked down longer. Recharges Fierce Blow if you control a foe with this ability.
<c=reminder>Recharges Fierce Blow if striking a target with a defiance bar.</c>

14512.name: Earthshaker
14512.description: Burst. Jump to the targeted location and slam your hammer down, damaging and stunning foes.

14516.name: Bull's Charge
14516.description: Physical. Charge and knock down your foe.

14518.name: Crushing Blow
14518.description:
Crush your opponent's armor, leaving them vulnerable and gaining might. Vulnerability and might stacks doubled if you hit a disabled foe.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

14519.name: Fan of Fire
14519.description: Fire a spread of three flaming arrows, burning foes.

14520.name: Combustive Shot
14520.description: Burst. Ignite target area, burning nearby foes. Effect increases with adrenaline level.

14528.name: Banner of Defense
14528.description: Banner. Place a banner that grants barrier and boons on initial placement, then pulses additional boons to you and nearby allies afterward.

14544.name: Forceful Shot
14544.description: Burst. Fire a forceful shot. Damage increases with adrenaline level.

14545.name: Arcing Slice
14545.description: Burst. Deliver a circular attack to foes around you, and gain fury. Deal more damage to foes with low health.

14548.name: Tactical Blow
14548.description: Stop blocking and swing out with an attack.

14549.name: Whirling Strike
14549.description: Burst. Strike all foes around you, stunning them. Effect increases with adrenaline level.

14552.name: Mariner's Shot
14552.description: Shoot your foe from long range. The farther the shot goes, the more damage it does.

14554.name: Hundred Blades
14554.description: Repeatedly strike multiple foes. The last strike does extra damage.

14557.name: Adrenaline Rush
14557.description: Stop blocking and swing out with an attack.

14568.name: "Shake It Off!"
14568.description: Shout. Cure conditions on yourself and nearby allies.

14575.name: "On My Mark!"
14575.description: Shout. Call out target foe to make them vulnerable.

21813.name: Lesser Endure Pain
21813.description: Stance. Take no damage from attacks. You are still susceptible to conditions and control effects.

21815.name: Defiant Stance
21815.description: Stance. Heal yourself. Absorb all incoming strikes for a period of time.

29613.name: Sundering Leap
29613.description: Rage. Leap to a location, dealing damage and inflicting conditions on all foes in the area. Extends the duration of berserk mode if it hits.

29644.name: Gun Flame
29644.description: Primal Burst. Fire a fast, flaming shot that explodes on the first foe it hits, interrupting foes in the area.

29679.name: Skull Grinder
29679.description: Primal Burst. Unleash a powerful skull strike that dazes your target and inflicts multiple conditions.

29845.name: Blaze Breaker
29845.description: Smash your torch into the ground, creating a deadly shock wave that conditions foes.

29852.name: Arc Divider
29852.description: Primal Burst. Spin to create a violent shock wave that damages nearby foes.

29923.name: Scorched Earth
29923.description: Primal Burst. Fire a burning shot into the ground that creates a trail of flaming destruction.

29940.name: Flames of War
29940.description: Cleanse conditions and become a mobile fire field that burns nearby foes. When the field expires, it explodes, damaging foes and burning them again.

29941.name: Wild Blow
29941.description: Rage. Lash out with a critical attack that knocks down your foes. Extend the duration of berserk mode if this attack hits.

30074.name: Shattering Blow
30074.description: Rage. Summon a rock that blocks attacks, then shatter it to send out rock fragments that inflict bleeding on all foes in front of you. Extends the duration of berserk mode if it hits.

30185.name: Berserk
30185.description: Rage. Gain adrenaline, an attack-speed boost, and access to primal burst skills.

30189.name: Blood Reckoning
30189.description: Rage. Heal yourself, gain adrenaline, and recharge all primal burst skills. Heal for a percentage of your outgoing damage. This skill extends the duration of berserk mode.

30258.name: Outrage
30258.description: Rage. Break out of stun and extend the duration of berserk mode. The extension of berserk mode increases if an enemy is nearby.

30343.name: Head Butt
30343.description: Rage. Stun your target and stun yourself. Gain adrenaline and extend berserk duration if you hit.

30435.name: Berserk
30435.description: Rage. Gain adrenaline, an attack-speed boost, and access to primal burst skills.

30682.name: Flaming Flurry
30682.description: Primal Burst. Lash out with a flurry of strikes that block missiles and shoot fireballs at foes in front of you.

30851.name: Decapitate
30851.description: Primal Burst. Gather your strength into a powerful attack. If it hits, gain might and recharge this skill.

30879.name: Rupturing Smash
30879.description: Primal Burst. Jump to the targeted location and slam your hammer down, creating a deadly chain of earthen shock waves that immobilize and daze foes.

30989.name: Burning Shackles
30989.description: Primal Burst. Fire a fast, forceful shot that immobilizes and burns foes.

31048.name: Wild Whirl
31048.description: Primal Burst. Strike all foes around you, burning and pulling them in.

34296.name: Brutal Shot
34296.description: Evade backward while firing an immobilizing shot.

39972.name: Silencer
39972.description: Burst. Briefly stun your target. If you hit a target using a skill, recover some adrenaline.

40275.name: Keen Strike
40275.description: Chain. Strike your foe and gain might. Gain additional might on critical hit.

40560.name: Focused Slash
40560.description: Chain. Strike your foe. This attack has increased critical-hit damage.

40601.name: Earthshaker
40601.description: Burst. Jump to the targeted location and slam your hammer down, damaging and stunning foes.

41100.name: Natural Healing
41100.description: Meditation. Heal for a percentage of your maximum health.

41110.name: Skull Crack
41110.description: Burst. Stun your foe with a skull crack.

41283.name: Boon Crusher
41283.description: Burst. Strike your foe and remove boons. Stunned, dazed, or knocked-down foes are immobilized.

41543.name: Wounding Strike
41543.description: Burst. Strike your foe, inflicting bleeding. If you hit a foe using a skill, additional bleeding and torment are inflicted.

41746.name: Whirling Strike
41746.description: Burst. Strike all foes around you, stunning them.

41919.name: Imminent Threat
41919.description: Meditation. Taunt nearby foes, gaining adrenaline and barrier for each affected foe.

42041.name: Kill Shot
42041.description: Burst. Fire a powerful shot. Deal increased damage to enemies that are affected by crowd control or below the health threshold.

42707.name: Arcing Slice
42707.description: Burst. Deliver a circular attack to foes around you, and gain fury. Deal more damage to foes with low health.

42745.name: Precise Cut
42745.description: Chain. Strike your foe. This attack deals increased critical damage.

42803.name: Combustive Shot
42803.description: Burst. Ignite the target area, burning nearby foes.

43123.name: Break Enchantments
43123.description: Meditation. Strike foes around you and remove their boons. Deal more damage to foes that lose a boon.

43488.name: Fleeting Stability
43488.description: Burst. Bash your foe with your shield and stun them.

43532.name: Magebane Tether
43532.description: Tether yourself to your target. If they move beyond the range threshold, pull them to you. Grants might and reveals your target every second.

43566.name: Eviscerate
43566.description: Burst. Leap at your foe with a devastating attack.

43745.name: Sight beyond Sight
43745.description: Meditation. Reveal nearby foes and make your next attack a critical hit. Remove blindness and nondamaging conditions.

44004.name: Wastrel's Ruin
44004.description: Strike your target and remove boons. Damage and boon removal are increased against foes not using skills or those that are defiant.

44165.name: Full Counter
44165.description: Burst. Absorb the next attack against you and counterattack all foes around you. Foes struck by the counter attack are interrupted.

44397.name: Dissonance
44397.description: Burst. Release a conical wave of sound that blows away boons on targets it hits. Stuns foes using skills.

44937.name: Disrupting Stab
44937.description: Dazes your target. If your target is using a skill, the daze duration is extended.

45160.name: Hushblade
45160.description: Strike out in a cone before you. Enemies struck are dazed.

45252.name: Breaching Strike
45252.description: Burst. Strike your target and remove boons. Deal more damage if your target has no boons.

45333.name: Winds of Disenchantment
45333.description: Meditation. Create an area of calm in which foes have reduced incoming boon duration and lose boons every interval. Enemy missiles entering this area are blocked.

45380.name: Featherfoot Grace
45380.description: Meditation. Gain a burst of superspeed and resistance.

46044.name: Magehunter Strike
46044.description: Burst. Critically strike your target. This attack cannot be blocked and does increased damage for each boon on your target.

46233.name: Aura Slicer
46233.description: Leap and strike your foe, inflicting slow.

62697.name: Gunstinger
62697.description: Quickly step forward to strike your foe while reloading your gun. Restores ammo to skill 5.

62745.name: Unsheathe Gunsaber
62745.description: Unsheathe your gunsaber to gain new skills. Changes to your weapon recharge rate affect this skill.

62800.name: Dragon's Roar
62800.description: Fire all the barrels in your hand cannon to deal damage to foes in front of you. This skill consumes all your ammo when fired and pushes you back slightly based on the amount of ammo expended.

62803.name: Dragon Trigger
62803.description:
Prepare to use Dragon Slash. While channeling, you drain flow. Each interval increases the charge level of Dragon Slash.
This skill is canceled if you dodge or are interrupted.

62804.name: Electric Fence
62804.description: Armament. Throw a device that leaves behind a wall of energy, blocking projectiles and crippling foes that pass through it. Foes that are already crippled become immobilized.

62847.name: Unseen Sword
62847.description: After a delay, deliver a circular attack to foes around you. Increases flow rate if it hits.

62861.name: Sheathe Gunsaber
62861.description: Put your gunsaber away and return to your normal weapon set. Changes to your weapon recharge rate affect this skill.

62901.name: Tactical Reload
62901.description: Armament. Reload ammo on all of your bladesworn skills. Your next Dragon Trigger generates more charges per interval.

62960.name: Dragonspike Mine
62960.description: Armament. Evade backward while triggering an explosion that inflicts conditions on foes. This skill recharges Dragon Trigger.

62967.name: Flow Stabilizer
62967.description: Armament. Increase flow rate and gain fury. If you already have fury, gain additional flow.

62969.name: Flow
62969.description: Flow is gained at a constant rate while in combat and decays quickly when combat ends. Attacking will not generate flow, and flow cannot be used for core warrior burst skills. Skills and traits that generate adrenaline will have their adrenaline gain converted to flow.

62978.name: Combat Stimulant
62978.description: Armament. Heal yourself and enter Stim State. When Stim State expires, you are healed again. Using this skill while in Stim State grants boons.

68085.name: Overcharged Cartridges
68085.description: Armament. Your explosion attacks deal more damage and inflict burning. Using this skill while you already have Overcharged Cartridges activated causes you to supercharge your cartridges, increasing its effectiveness and refreshing its duration.

69290.name: Slicing Maelstrom
69290.description: Primal Burst. Slice nearby enemies, removing boons and gaining adrenaline per boon removed. Deal more damage if your target has no boons.

69297.name: Breaching Strike
69297.description: Burst. Strike your target and remove boons. Deal more damage if your target has no boons.

69433.name: Breaching Strike
69433.description: Burst. Strike your target and remove boons. Deal more damage if your target has no boons.

71860.name: Line Breaker
71860.description: Charge to the target location. When you arrive, heal nearby allies and grant them boons while debilitating nearby enemies.

71875.name: Rampart Splitter
71875.description: Primal Burst. Slam your staff on the ground, sending a shock wave forward that damages and immobilizes enemies while inspiring nearby allies, healing and granting regeneration to them.

71889.name: Defiant Roar
71889.description: Unleash a defiant roar, healing nearby allies and granting them resolution.

71922.name: Path to Victory
71922.description: Burst. Carve a path to victory, dealing damage to enemies in front of you while healing and granting regeneration to nearby allies.

71932.name: Path to Victory
71932.description: Burst. Carve a path to victory, dealing damage to enemies in front of you while healing and granting regeneration to nearby allies.

71950.name: Path to Victory
71950.description: Burst. Carve a path to victory, dealing damage to enemies in front of you while healing and granting regeneration to nearby allies.

72001.name: Reverse Strike
72001.description: Chain. A follow-up reverse-handed staff strike.

72002.name: Valiant Leap
72002.description: Leap to the targeted location, empowering allies and damaging enemies. Gain adrenaline if you affect another ally.

72026.name: Snap Pull
72026.description: Quickly snap your staff to pull enemies in and make them vulnerable.

72029.name: Path to Victory
72029.description: Burst. Carve a path to victory, dealing damage to enemies in front of you while healing and granting regeneration to nearby allies.

72049.name: Inspiring Whirl
72049.description: Whirl your staff, damaging nearby enemies and inspiring allies.

72089.name: Path to Victory
72089.description: Burst. Carve a path to victory, dealing damage to enemies in front of you while healing and granting regeneration to nearby allies.

72897.name: Maiming Spear
72897.description: Throw your spear at a targeted location, damaging and inflicting conditions on opponents in the area and causing an aftershock after a short delay. The aftershock deals more damage to the opponent closest to the epicenter.

72911.name: Harrier's Toss
72911.description: Burst. Jump up and throw a spear at your targeted location, dealing damage in an area. Damage dealt is increased with adrenaline level, and the opponent closest to the epicenter takes additional damage.

72958.name: Mighty Throw
72958.description: Throw a spear at your enemy that shatters on contact, scattering shards that damage enemies around the initial target.

72959.name: Disrupting Throw
72959.description: Throw a spear that pierces foes in a line, immobilizing them. The first enemy struck by this skill is additionally dazed.

72992.name: Spearmarshal's Support
72992.description: Mark a single target; after a short delay, bombard the area with spears that deal more damage to the marked target and continue to track their location.

73006.name: Harrier's Toss
73006.description: Burst. Jump up and throw a spear at your targeted location, dealing damage in an area. Damage dealt is increased with adrenaline level, and the opponent closest to the epicenter takes additional damage.

73009.name: Spear Swipe
73009.description: Jump up and evade attacks, then swipe forward, sending a wave of air in front of you that pushes you backward, knocks enemies back, and reflects projectiles. The first enemy struck is launched instead of knocked back. Evading an attack reduces the cooldown of this skill.

73014.name: Harrier's Toss
73014.description: Burst. Jump up and throw a spear at your targeted location, dealing damage in an area. The opponent closest to the epicenter takes additional damage.

73024.name: Harrier's Toss
73024.description: Burst. Jump up and throw a spear at your targeted location, dealing damage in an area. Damage dealt is increased with adrenaline level, and the opponent closest to the epicenter takes additional damage.

73042.name: Harrier's Toss
73042.description: Burst. Jump up and throw a spear at your targeted location, dealing damage in an area. Damage dealt is increased with adrenaline level, and the opponent closest to the epicenter takes additional damage.

73103.name: Wild Throw
73103.description: Primal Burst. Throw several piercing spears that inflict vulnerability in quick succession.

76562.name: "We Will Never Yield!"
76562.description:
Command. Your allies' health cannot be reduced below zero for a short period of time. After this effect ends, grant barrier proportionate to their missing health. Certain boss skills may bypass the effect of this skill.
Echo. Grant superspeed to nearby allies after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

76755.name: "We Shall Return!"
76755.description:
Command.  Heal yourself and allies in an area around you. 
Echo.  Heals again and removes conditions on allies after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

76769.name: "Never Surrender!"
76769.description:
Command. Break stun while granting boons to nearby allies. The cooldown of this skill is increased if used to break a stun.
Echo. Grant additional boons to nearby allies after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

76782.name: Chant of Recuperation
76782.description:
Burst. Chant. Grants barrier to allies in an area around you. 

Refrain. After activation, continually pulses healing to allies while removing motivation stacks every interval. This effect lasts until you run out of motivation stacks or another chant is activated. Gain increased effects depending on motivation stacks:

76934.name: "Brace Yourselves!"
76934.description:
Command. Apply barrier to yourself and allies around you. 
Echo.  Apply barrier again to allies after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

77040.name: "Find Their Weakness!"
77040.description:
Command. Strike enemies around your target, inflicting vulnerability and spreading vulnerability from your original target to nearby enemies.
Echo. Apply might to allies and gain adrenaline based on the number of enemies struck after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

77114.name: "On Your Knees!"
77114.description:
Command. Damage and apply conditions to enemies around you.
Echo. Damage and immobilize enemies after a set interval or after you use a burst skill.

77155.name: Chant of Freedom
77155.description:
Burst. Chant. Breaks stun from allies in an area around you. 

Refrain. When activated, continually applies swiftness to allies while removing motivation stacks every interval. This effect lasts until you run out of motivation stacks or another chant is activated. Gains increased effects depending on motivation stacks:

77342.name: Chant of Action
77342.description:
Burst. Chant. Applies boons to allies in an area around you.

Refrain. After activation, continually applies boons to allies while removing motivation every interval. This effect lasts until you run out of motivation stacks or another chant is activated. Gain increased effects depending on motivation stacks:

80203.name: Bloodthirster
80203.description: Burst. Sweep your blade around yourself, slicing nearby enemies. Effect increases with adrenaline level. Heal if you strike a target, healing more if they are bleeding. Healing scales off of the target struck that is bleeding the most.

80247.name: Rend
80247.description: Maim your target with an immobilizing strike, then deliver a devastating blow that inflicts heavy bleeding.

80252.name: Bloodthirster
80252.description: Burst. Sweep your blade around yourself, slicing nearby enemies. Effect increases with adrenaline level. Heal if you strike a target, healing more if they are bleeding. Healing scales off of the target struck that is bleeding the most.

80263.name: Bloodthirster
80263.description: Burst. Sweep your blade around yourself, slicing nearby enemies. Effect increases with adrenaline level. Heal if you strike a target, healing more if they are bleeding. Healing scales off of the target struck that is bleeding the most.
